test_NeuralBandit_basic: test the NeuralBandit policy learner with random state action batches and verify loss convergence
run_NeuralBandit_learn_batch: run learn_batch on a NeuralBandit with TransitionBatch data to train the policy over multiple epochs
run_NeuralBandit_get_scores: run get_scores on a trained NeuralBandit to obtain action scores for a given state and action space
run_NeuralBandit_act: run act on a NeuralBandit to select optimal actions given a subjective state and available action space
create_TransitionBatch: create a TransitionBatch with state action reward and weight tensors for training a contextual bandit policy
